Hi Alice,

Great to meet earlier today — thanks for taking the time. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery: 

- Goals: reduce inference latency for search ranking and prod chat while keeping data isolated for PII workflows.
- Key constraints: SOC 2 evidence, data residency in US, and a procurement review in mid-March.

As promised, I attached our SOC 2 security packet. It includes the SOC 2 report summary, control matrix, and a short architecture diagram showing how customer data is isolated at rest and in-transit.

Next suggested steps:
1) Your security team reviews the packet (I recommend the control matrix first)
2) If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min call with our security lead to walk through any controls (I copied Rishi who can join)
3) If everything looks good, we can scope a pilot and get procurement engaged.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Security_Packet_2027.pdf (pdf, 2.4MB)

Any questions, or does Tuesday/Wednesday next week work for a short call?

Thanks —

Hi Alice —

Just bumping this thread to check if there are any blockers on the SOC 2 review. Wanted to surface a couple items that usually come up so your team has them up front:
- KMS/HSM: We support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS or customer HSM for private deployments; for hosted offerings we provide an option to integrate with customer KMS for key ownership.
- Data residency: We can pin inference to US regions; for Dedicated/Private deployments customers can choose on-prem or VPC options.

If it'd help, happy to book a 30-minute sync with our security engineer to walk through these details. Would Wednesday 10am ET or Thursday 2pm ET work?

Best,
Marissa
